selection.ordering: reverse whitelist index; newest timestamps UNKNOWN (not exposed in whitelist)

interpretation_constraints: Mechanical evidence only; no scientific verdicts or source/assessment prose in summary.
Raw bounded host results preserved verbatim, including incidental transcript content; no source or assessment artifacts opened.
Cumulative native meters retained individually and never summed, including repeated snapshots. Native raw tokens are not billing tokens.
Missing fields UNKNOWN. Candidate originals not mutated; no provider fallbacks or new runs.
Whitelist contains no recency timestamps. Reverse whitelist position is a documented ordering proxy, not verified newest-by-time.
For contexts 5-24 recorded finish times are batch-finalization upper bounds, not exact tool-return times; exact host item timestamps are preserved.
